what: Vintage seller reports that Etsy began eliminating the option for sellers to charge retail shipping rates, forcing discounted label rates, and describes the change as micromanaging that erodes profit margins.
verbatim_snippet: "I made a sale on Tuesday and the customer was charged the discounted rate. I checked my settings and they were set to the retail rate so I contacted Etsy help and was told that they are in the process of eliminating that because sellers shouldn't charge more than what they pay for the shipping. This is Etsy move to be more 'transparent'. The problem is sometimes I need to ad more insurance or I underestimate the packed weight not to mention the the transaction fee. I wish Etsy would stop micromanaging and stop nibbling away my small profit."
notes: community.etsy.com requires login. Content retrieved from Google search index. Poster: GenevaMarketVintage. Vintage seller. Policy change: elimination of retail shipping rate option, effective approximately May 27, 2025. Affects sellers using calculated shipping. Concerns cited: insurance cost coverage, weight estimation error, transaction fee on shipping.
